This petition coming on for admission this day, th e cour
 following:
 Order
Counsel for the petitioner by the instant petition is challenging the order passed by the Collector,
Panna on 30.06.2023 (Annexure P-3) rejecting the application moved by the petitioner under section 64 of the Right to Fare Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation &
Resettlement Act, 2013.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The Collector, Panna/respondent no.2 has no power to decide the said application on merit or even on the ground of limitation and the order is without jurisdiction.
Therefore, the order dated 30.06.2023 is set aside.
The Collector, Panna is directed to refer the dispute to the competent court i.e Additional District Judge for entertaining the reference under section 64 of the Right to Fare Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013.
The aforesaid exercise be completed by the Collector, Panna within a period of 30 days from the date of submitting a copy of this order passed today.
Accordingly, this petition is allowed and disposed of.
